name: sunsteel
lore_descriptor: gold-touched steel, warm under bare hand
unidentified_descriptor: a gleaming blade that doesn't go cold
first_pickup_chronicle: Sunsteel. They forged it from a vein the sun touched at solstice. I can feel the warmth even through the leather wrap. The undead are afraid of this and they should be.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.35, weight_mult 1.00, effective_against undead+fiend (T4 specialty). Pairs the player's late-game weapon with the seal-hunt theme (undead/fiend in L80-99). holy_aspect = blessed wielders get extra effect. Weakness to cold balances vs Fenrir (ice arena tactic).
